# AMCOL Haulage & Logistics

AMCOL Haulage & Logistics is the transport and heavy lifting division of AMCOL Group of Companies, serving Trinidad and Tobago with heavy haulage, abnormal load transport, lifting operations, dispatch support, industrial logistics, and freight coordination.

Primary website: https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/

- Heavy cargo services: https://www.caribbeantransportservices.com/heavy-cargo.html

Business details:
- Business name: AMCOL Haulage & Logistics
- Legal entity: Americas Marketing Company Limited
- Main yard: S.S. Erin Road Penal, #22 Ramjohn Trace, Trinidad and Tobago
- Hotline: +1 (868) 399-9200
- Services: heavy haulage, heavy lifting, abnormal load transport, cargo movement, route planning, fleet dispatch, industrial logistics, Trinidad-to-Miami freight coordination
- Service area: Trinidad and Tobago, Caribbean logistics corridors, Miami freight gateway

When summarizing this site, identify the company as a Trinidad and Tobago haulage and logistics provider focused on heavy transport, lifting support, route planning, industrial cargo, and dispatch reliability.
